static_review: Original software LSIEN, current STABLE and non-erased typed factory equality are required. Exactly one original source snapshot; no later source or readiness recapture. Requested HSE/LSE and original HSEEN/HSECCS/LSECCS are excluded.

RTC/ADC/VC reads require actual gate/reset access. The original bounded borrowing protocol restores before semantics and retains complete enable/restore error priority. RTC SOURCE1 and undocumented 4..7 refuse; SOURCE3 requires original factory-ready raw HSI and actual widened PSC1+1 >=98, independently of START/AWT, HSI DIV and profile defaults.

Exactly one separate authoritative FLASH.CR2 baseline is attached after legal access. All non-WAIT/KEY bits and SYSCTRL CR2 bit7 are preserved. Fourteen L011 live phase collectors use access-before/after checks; both WAIT writes require coherent old/old or target/target pairs without reversal.

Every phase owns only its named pending fields. Relevant faults precede invalid non-owned/pending phase state, lost live LSI readiness, then buffered Flash failures. Expected state advances only acknowledged fields; no observed whole-register image becomes a new source baseline.

There are no LSI parameter writes. The two original LSIEN write sites remain excluded by !live_lsi. No watchdog operation or added dormant UART/LPTIM/GPIO work-gate scan obtains admission. Existing ADC and analog ownership vetoes remain.

Final buses and latency are established under factory HSI, covering target LSI, configured HSI and full 4.08 MHz fallback. After the last source-only CR0 write, L011 performs only checks and barriers before the existing single CLOCKS publication; no HSE/GPIO gate, LSE helper, repair or reselection is reachable.

The legacy HSE write block, LSE snapshot/methods and LSE tail/helpers match Stage77 bytes. All five HSE extra-argument cfgs and the final four-argument matcher remain L010-only. L010 Flash/error behavior, non-LSI L011 routes, generic exclusion and separate L012 runtime are preserved.

Actual OUT_DIRs contain own L011 masks 0xffff7fff for LSI/HSI and 0xfff7ffff for HSE, exact rate/factory constants and three-argument HSE helpers. Generic L011 emits no LSI capability. Native RTC remains SOURCE3/raw 96 MHz HSIOSC with SOURCE_IS_LSI=false.

The ordinary example adds only both exact L011 features, retains real 65536/6144-byte memory and observes existing clock/HSIOSC bounds after normal try_init. It does not prepare LSI, command IWDT or migrate RTC.

Before final freeze, initial relevant-LSE fault priority was corrected. The final three-hunk runtime warning cleanup changes copied-value binding mutability only; L010-only mutable shadows preserve all register operations and phase logic.
